statements.text: The woman is closing a cabinet drawer.
The woman is placing a folder in a filing cabinet.
The woman is carrying a stack of boxes.
The woman is writing on a whiteboard.

items.correctExplanation: The photograph clearly shows the woman placing a folder inside an open filing cabinet.

distractorExplanations.A: The drawer is open, but she is filing a folder rather than closing it.
distractorExplanations.C: There are office materials nearby, but she is not carrying boxes.
distractorExplanations.D: No whiteboard is present; the action takes place beside a filing cabinet.

languageFocus: Present progressive for an action in progress

statements.text: Some people are entering the conference room.
The chairs have been stacked against a wall.
Several chairs are arranged around a table.
A projector is being removed from the ceiling.

items.correctExplanation: The empty conference room contains several chairs positioned around the central table.

distractorExplanations.A: The room is empty, so nobody is entering it.
distractorExplanations.B: The chairs are set around the table, not stacked against a wall.
distractorExplanations.D: Nothing is being removed, and the room has no visible worker.

languageFocus: Passive state descriptions with are arranged

statements.text: A worker is pushing boxes on a hand truck.
A worker is lifting a box onto a high shelf.
Some packages are being opened on the floor.
The warehouse shelves are completely empty.

items.correctExplanation: The worker has both hands on a hand truck and is moving a load of cardboard boxes.

distractorExplanations.B: The worker is pushing the load, not lifting a box onto a shelf.
distractorExplanations.C: The packages are closed and are being transported rather than opened.
distractorExplanations.D: Many goods are visible on the warehouse shelving.

statements.text: A customer is reading a menu at the table.
The tables are being folded and stored indoors.
A server is carrying food into the kitchen.
A server is setting an outdoor table.

items.correctExplanation: The server is arranging items on a table in an outdoor restaurant seating area.

distractorExplanations.A: No customer is seated or reading a menu in the photograph.
distractorExplanations.B: The tables are ready for use outdoors and are not being folded.
distractorExplanations.C: The server is at an outdoor table, not carrying food into a kitchen.

languageFocus: Set a table as a common workplace collocation

statements.text: The travelers are lining up at a ticket counter.
Several travelers are seated beside their luggage.
The passengers are placing bags on a conveyor belt.
An attendant is collecting suitcases from the floor.

items.correctExplanation: Three travelers are sitting in an airport waiting area with luggage positioned next to them.

distractorExplanations.A: They are seated in a waiting area rather than standing at a counter.
distractorExplanations.C: Their luggage remains beside them and is not on a conveyor belt.
distractorExplanations.D: No attendant is present or collecting the travelers' suitcases.

statements.text: The worker is rolling up an empty sheet of paper.
Some building materials are being loaded onto a truck.
A supervisor is examining a blueprint at a construction site.
The supervisor is repairing a piece of machinery.

items.correctExplanation: The helmeted supervisor is looking closely at an open blueprint at the construction site.

distractorExplanations.A: The large sheet is open for examination rather than being rolled up.
distractorExplanations.B: Construction materials are visible, but nobody is loading a truck.
distractorExplanations.D: The supervisor is studying plans and is not repairing machinery.

languageFocus: Examine as a precise visual-action verb

statements.text: A receptionist is handing a key card to a guest.
A guest is carrying luggage through a doorway.
The receptionist is speaking on the telephone.
Some keys are hanging from the wall.

items.correctExplanation: At the hotel desk, the receptionist is visibly passing a key card to the guest.

distractorExplanations.B: The guest is standing at the desk and is not carrying luggage.
distractorExplanations.C: The receptionist is serving the guest, not using a telephone.
distractorExplanations.D: The visible object is a key card being handed over, not keys on a wall.

statements.text: A passenger is waiting inside a parked car.
A conductor is checking tickets on the platform.
The train doors have been closed to passengers.
A passenger is boarding a train.

items.correctExplanation: The passenger is stepping through an open doorway to board the train from the platform.

distractorExplanations.A: The person is beside a train, not waiting inside a car.
distractorExplanations.B: No conductor is visible and no tickets are being checked.
distractorExplanations.C: The train doorway is open while the passenger boards.

statements.text: The workers are directing traffic around a vehicle.
Two workers are painting a line on the road.
The workers are measuring the height of a street sign.
Some tools have been packed into a roadside box.

items.correctExplanation: The two workers are applying paint to create a lane marking on the road surface.

distractorExplanations.A: They are working on a road line rather than directing moving traffic.
distractorExplanations.C: No street sign is being measured in the scene.
distractorExplanations.D: Their painting equipment is in use and has not been packed away.

languageFocus: Paint a line as a direct-object construction

statements.text: The employee is removing every product from a shelf.
A customer is comparing labels near the checkout counter.
An employee is stocking cans on a store shelf.
Several containers have fallen into the aisle.

items.correctExplanation: The store employee is placing canned products onto a shelf to replenish the display.

distractorExplanations.A: The employee is adding products to the shelf rather than removing all of them.
distractorExplanations.B: The pictured person is an employee stocking goods, not a customer at checkout.
distractorExplanations.D: The cans are orderly on the shelf and have not fallen into the aisle.

languageFocus: Stock a shelf as a retail collocation

statements.text: A factory worker is inspecting a metal component.
A mechanic is installing a wheel on a vehicle.
The worker is sweeping beneath a conveyor belt.
Finished products are being wrapped for delivery.

items.correctExplanation: The worker is holding and closely examining a metal component beside industrial equipment.

distractorExplanations.B: The round component may resemble a wheel, but no vehicle is present.
distractorExplanations.C: The worker is inspecting a part and is not cleaning beneath the conveyor.
distractorExplanations.D: No products are being wrapped or prepared for delivery.

languageFocus: Inspect versus install in workplace descriptions

statements.text: A gardener is trimming branches from a tree.
Some flowers are being transferred into pots.
The garden hose has been coiled beside a shed.
A groundskeeper is watering a bed of flowers.

items.correctExplanation: The groundskeeper is using a hose to water flowers planted together in a garden bed.

distractorExplanations.A: The worker is watering low flowers, not trimming branches from a tree.
distractorExplanations.B: The flowers remain planted in the garden and are not being moved to pots.
distractorExplanations.C: The hose is extended and in use rather than coiled beside a shed.

languageFocus: Water used as an action verb

statements.text: The presenter is erasing numbers from a board.
A presenter is pointing to a bar chart.
The audience is leaving the meeting room.
A chart is being carried through the doorway.

items.correctExplanation: The presenter is standing beside the display and pointing directly at a bar chart.

distractorExplanations.A: The presenter is indicating the chart, not erasing anything.
distractorExplanations.C: No audience members are shown leaving the room.
distractorExplanations.D: The chart is displayed in place and is not being carried.

statements.text: A driver is washing the side of a delivery van.
Several boxes are stacked on top of the van.
A courier is unloading a box from a van.
A customer is signing for a package indoors.

items.correctExplanation: The courier is carrying a cardboard box away from the open cargo area of the van.

distractorExplanations.A: The courier is moving a package and is not washing the vehicle.
distractorExplanations.B: The boxes are in or beside the cargo area, not stacked on the roof.
distractorExplanations.D: No customer is visible and the action is taking place outdoors.

statements.text: A mechanic is tightening the front wheel of a bicycle.
A cyclist is inflating both tires with a pump.
Several bicycles are being loaded onto a rack.
The mechanic is polishing the bicycle seat.

items.correctExplanation: The bicycle mechanic is using a tool at the front wheel to tighten its hardware.

distractorExplanations.B: The person is a mechanic using a hand tool, and no pump is visible.
distractorExplanations.C: The bicycle is being repaired in place rather than loaded onto a rack.
distractorExplanations.D: The mechanic is working near the front wheel, not polishing the seat.

languageFocus: Tighten as a precise maintenance verb

statements.text: The chef is placing plates inside an oven.
Some vegetables are being washed in a sink.
The cook is serving a finished meal to a customer.
A chef is slicing red peppers on a cutting board.

items.correctExplanation: The chef is using a knife to cut red bell peppers on a kitchen cutting board.

distractorExplanations.A: The chef is cutting vegetables and is not placing plates in an oven.
distractorExplanations.B: The peppers are on a cutting board rather than being washed in a sink.
distractorExplanations.C: No customer or finished meal is present in the kitchen scene.

statements.text: A shopper is taking a spare tire out of a vehicle.
A shopper is placing a bag into an open trunk.
The vehicle is being repaired beside a shopping cart.
Several grocery bags are lined up on the roof.

items.correctExplanation: The shopper is moving a shopping bag into the raised, open trunk of the car.

distractorExplanations.A: The person is loading a bag rather than removing a spare tire.
distractorExplanations.C: No repairs are occurring; the vehicle is simply being loaded.
distractorExplanations.D: The bag is going into the trunk and none are lined up on the roof.

languageFocus: Place an object into a container

statements.text: The passengers are getting off a bus at the final stop.
A driver is inspecting the front of a bus.
Two passengers are boarding a city bus.
Some luggage has been placed beneath the bus.

items.correctExplanation: Two passengers are stepping toward and through the open entrance of the city bus.

distractorExplanations.A: Their direction of movement shows that they are boarding, not getting off.
distractorExplanations.B: The people are passengers at the entrance, and no driver is inspecting the bus.
distractorExplanations.D: No luggage is visible beneath the bus in the photograph.

languageFocus: Board versus get off for transportation
